products.name: LlamaIndex
products.note: RAG framework; data connectors; indexing strategies; enterprise RAG governance

profile_text.body:
LlamaIndex is an AI infrastructure company whose primary offering is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework that includes data connectors, indexing strategies, and enterprise RAG governance tooling. The company describes its flagship product, LlamaParse, as an agentic OCR system built for processing complex documents containing messy tables, charts, and images, claiming human-level accuracy and describing it as powered by vision-language models. The company also offers an open-source document parsing tool for extracting text from PDFs, Office documents, and images that requires no cloud connection, LLM tokens, or usage limits.

The company describes its technology as serving enterprise use cases across financial services, manufacturing, and healthcare, with customers said to include banks, hedge funds, fintechs, manufacturers, and healthcare providers using LlamaParse for workflows such as financial due diligence, invoice processing, extraction from technical manuals and inspection reports, and processing of medical records and insurance claims. The held facts confirm that LlamaIndex maintains a tracked product under the coding and developer tools category, covering the RAG framework, data connectors, indexing, and enterprise governance functions.
